objective: Fix the discrete adjoint linear solve conditioning that blocks field inversion on every closure relevant case, starting from the two levers that already convert the catastrophic failure into honest stagnation
rationale: Field inversion capability is now proven and finite difference verified on a five thousand cell tutorial case at about 1.7 core minutes per gradient, and the mesh warp defect that fails the airfoil and the U bend is measured absent from the beta chain, so the only thing between this lab and Stage 1 is one linear solve. Both closure relevant cases fail identically: the curved backward facing step at twenty one thousand cells and the NASA hump at fifty one thousand six hundred cells both return PETSc reason minus nine with zero iterations. Memory is measured not to be the cause on the hump, peak about eleven gigabytes with nineteen gigabytes still free and Jacobian colouring completing normally. Four mechanisms were tested on the hump: wall treatment and the velocity limiter are refuted, while switching off residual normalization and switching the Jacobian reordering from reverse Cuthill McKee to natural each remove the NaN and leave a flat residual. That is the same signature the transonic conditioning study reached on a completely different physics family, which points at one shared unfixed layer of ill conditioning rather than two case specific bugs. The untried threads that study named are a per region state normalization and a preconditioner family swap, the latter needing a rebuild because the type is hard coded after the options are read

launch_prompt: The field inversion capability is proven and FD verified, and the target case is blocked by one thing: the adjoint linear solve. Read the Stage 1 field inversion record and the R5 conditioning study first. On the NASA hump case, four mechanisms are already tested: wall treatment REFUTED, velocity limiter REFUTED, residual normalization off and natural Jacobian reordering each REMOVE the NaN but leave the GMRES residual flat to eleven digits. Do not retest those. The two named untried threads are a per region or per cell state normalization targeting the high aspect ratio near wall band, and a preconditioner family swap which needs a library rebuild because the type is set after the options are read. Every claim cites a log path and a timestamp. A measured negative is a complete answer.
outcome: DONE — gate met on the CBFS branch and independently verified. The -9 DIVERGED_NANORINF is a singular ASM sub-block incomplete factorization; complete LU in the sub-blocks (DAFOAM_SUBPC_TYPE=lu, off-by-default env switch in the rebuilt libDASolver, image dafoam-subpclu:v1) converges the CBFS adjoint (reason 2, 667 iters) on B3's exact -9 configuration, and the 21,000-DV beta-field gradient FD-verifies at 0.085/0.059/0.199 percent on the three published cells against the gate's 2.67-percent-order bar. Closure authorized on a fully-confirmed adversarial sweep (VERIFICATION_cbfs_unblock_supervisor_sweep.md, 2026-08-04): all five attack axes CONFIRMED — patch is one hunk and the built image's whole source tree diffs to exactly that hunk; FD table recomputed from raw perturbation vectors and logs; a NEW cell (6490, never published) re-derived by the verifier's own driver agrees at 0.0211 percent; the env-off regression re-run cold reproduces -9 with all 13 residual digits; the 185.0 core-min ledger reconciles to the second on three spot-checks; CBFS is training-legal (not among the 8 scored cases). Record: ladder-b/W4_ADJOINT_PC_UNBLOCK.md. Hump remains open as a different, honestly-named problem (Krylov rate vs memory envelope), on the record for a successor item. || CORRECTION, 2026-08-11 (hump-adjoint attempt audit; the CBFS half of this outcome is untouched and stands): the closing sentence about the hump is withdrawn as a causal claim. That attempt was killed by a docker stop at iteration 900 and never produced a KSPConvergedReason, so the convergence rate was never measured to completion and the memory envelope was never shown to be binding (an operator stopped the run, not an allocation failure). Curing a singular ASM sub-block incomplete factorization also does not establish that the matrix-free operator is nonsingular, and no rank or conditioning measurement exists on it, so the converse is unevidenced too. The correct statement is that no convergence was observed within the 900 iterations run and the hump adjoint boundary is UNCHARACTERISED. Six measurements would characterise it, priced at 365 core-min with the two cheapest and most decisive at 40, including the environment-off negative control that exists on CBFS and has never been run on the hump: ladder-b/W4_ADJOINT_PC_UNBLOCK.md section 5b.1.
